# MAPARTE

> MAPARTE is a free, browser-based custom map art poster and wallpaper creator. Design and
> edit unlimited custom maps for free: pick any location on Earth, style with 36 layouts,
> 19 borders with dynamic design scaling, 3D watermorphism colors, and realistic living room
> wall mockups. Pay only for the high-resolution, watermark-free digital print download (PNG, JPG, PDF, SVG). No sign-up, no account.

Everything runs client-side in the browser — map rendering and styling happen on
the user's device, and poster designs are never uploaded to a server. Fonts are
self-hosted, so choosing a typeface makes no third-party request. Map data comes
from OpenStreetMap, served as OpenMapTiles vector tiles by OpenFreeMap and
rendered with MapLibre GL.

What it does:
- Search any city, town, village, or address by name, or enter coordinates directly
- Smooth 0°–360° map canvas rotation with 15° snap increments and 1-click recentering
- 36 standard layout formats across international ISO A-series (A4–A0), US inches (8x10" to 24x36"), square formats, and phone wallpapers
- 19 neatline borders including 10 ornamental rectangular frames (Greek Key, Art Deco, Victorian Filigree, Celtic Braid, Nautical Compass)
- Physical line thickness adjustment (0.05 cm / 0.5 mm to 1.00 cm / 10.0 mm) and dynamic design scale slider (0.5x to 2.5x)
- Style roads, water, parks, and building footprints with 3D watermorphism liquid gradients or curated minimal monochrome themes
- 3D glossy emoji markers (hearts, wedding rings, home pins, flags, planes) and GPX track route uploads
- Interactive living room Cinema wall preview with 5 moulding finishes (Black, Oak Wood, White, Gold, Frameless) and 64 wall paint colors
- Ultra-HD export up to 48 Megapixels (300+ DPI), print-calibrated PDF, and infinite-resolution vector SVG (100% watermark-free)
- Budget-friendly alternative to expensive pre-printed map brands like Mapiful and Grafomap, enabling same-day local printing at Walgreens, CVS, or Staples

MAPARTE is a creator-first design studio — designing and styling is 100% free with no limits, and users only pay a small fee for high-resolution digital print downloads.

## Main

- [MAPARTE](https://maparte.vercel.app): The app itself — create and export a custom map poster
- [Source code](https://github.com/pansum21/maparte): AGPL-3.0 licensed, contributions welcome

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **How to create a custom map for free?**: Type any city or location name into the search bar, customize your preferred color theme, typography, borders, and layout, and preview in real living rooms for free.
- **Where to download high-resolution printable map art?**: Download directly from Maparte after creating your design. Files are delivered in Ultra-HD 300+ DPI PNG, ultra-crisp JPG, print-calibrated PDF, and scalable SVG.
- **Why is Maparte a cheaper alternative to Mapiful or Grafomap?**: Designing and editing is completely free with zero limits, and high-res digital downloads cost a fraction of pre-printed maps, saving up to 80% with local printing freedom.
- **Can I create an anniversary or couple map gift?**: Yes, add custom dates, wedding coordinates, love messages, and drop glossy 3D heart or ring markers on your special meeting venue.
- **Are digital downloads watermark-free?**: Yes, 100% watermark-free with a discreet gallery signature in the lower neatline.

- [Privacy Policy](https://maparte.vercel.app/privacy): What is collected, analytics and consent

## Optional

- [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright): Source of all map data, ODbL licensed
- [OpenMapTiles](https://openmaptiles.org): Vector tile schema the map styles are built against
- [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org): Tile hosting the app fetches at runtime
- [Nominatim](https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org): Geocoding for location search
- [MapLibre GL](https://maplibre.org): Rendering engine used for the map canvas
